title: Building a living pirate world with AI
author: Left-Prompt7557
selftext:
Over the past few months (or years even) I have been playing around with procedural generation and open world games experimenting with a bunch of different mechanics and systems.

More recently, a group of friends and I have been working towards turning these experiments into *Tales of the Eighth Sea*, a sprawling nautical world where people go about their lives, factions go to war and greater threats lurk in the deep...

The engine is Unity. The main coding LLM we use is Opus 5.5. The graphics are a mixture of sketches and reference photos which are then turned into 2D and 3D assets with ChatGPT and Meshy.

  
Last week we released our first public playtest on [itch.io](https://walnut-studio.itch.io/tales-of-the-eighth-sea), and have since spent much of the week burning through credits trying to address all the really useful feedback we received! Among other things, we've substantially reworked the opening tutorial, improved naval combat and settlement capture, and made quite a few visual improvements.

There's still an enormous amount to do, particularly with the storyline and animations, but it's finally starting to feel like a game rather than an endless series of experiments.

**If you fancy taking to the Eighth Sea, we'd love to hear what you think! The free playtest is available here:**

[https://walnut-studio.itch.io/tales-of-the-eighth-sea](https://walnut-studio.itch.io/tales-of-the-eighth-sea)
